en_US: Were you aware that any Porygon is
capable of evolving into a Porygon2?
You just need to Up-Grade it!
After a long walk in the mountains to
find a Pokémon Center, when you’re
just about to fall flat...
Then it feels like you are in paradise!
Hello, and welcome to
the Pokémon Center.
We restore your tired Pokémon
to full health.
Would you like to rest your
Pokémon? {YESNO 0}

messages.en_US: Please, come back again any time!

en_US: Archer: So, you’re the kid who’s been
messing with our plans? For someone so
young, I’m surprised you took out
Proton, Petrel and Ariana so easily...
Oh well, no matter. I can destroy
you right here!
Riley: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}! Hold on!
I’ll help you take these guys down!
Archer: Another contender? Very well,
this could actually be interesting.
But this isn’t the place.
I’ll be in front of the Safari Zone.
If you haven’t lost your nerve.
Archer: You there!
Let us fight together!
Archer: Hm. I wasn’t expecting that.
We have what we need regardless.
Don’t expect me to be so generous
next time!
Riley: Whew, that should free this area
from Team Rocket. You’ve been a great
help to us, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}. Thank you.
Incidentially, did you ever talk to
Bill? He has a gift for you that I
might’ve had something to do with...
What’s that? Bill gave you a Riolu
that came from me? Ah, so my aura
predicted correctly... I felt that
Riolu would be placed in the hands
of a good trainer, and it
appears I was right!
At any rate, people should start
returning to the area now that
those goons are gone.
I’ll see you around, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
I’ll see you in front of the
Safari Zone, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!
Just use that Up-Grade on any
Porygon, and it will evolve!
